doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

chapter: Eddie Vinson and the Pacific Brass Band
title: Eddie Vinson on saxophone and with the Barca, Olympia and Kepler bands
summary: Vinson also played saxophone and came to town in 1918. Martin lists the bands he later joined: George Barca's, the Olympia, and Freddie Keppard's, with Bill Johnson and Jimmy Palao also mentioned.
